## LV Backend Status — full health (Phase 25 Plan 02 + Phase 27 Plan 01, D-14)
`hubspot/backend-status`: three provider usage probes, then four HubSpot count searches, all run SEQUENTIALLY (never fanned out) so every probe — provider AND HubSpot alike — has completed before the single `Respond to Webhook` fires.

An unreadable balance (Apollo's non-master key 403s by design on this account) renders as an explicit `unreadable: true` / `credits: null` marker, never as zero (D-10/D-08). The two HubSpot counts (requested-unresolved, awaiting-review) are reported for companies AND contacts; a count the backend could not read is `null`, never `0` (STATUS-06). Reads only — zero write nodes anywhere in this chain.

**Webhook Trigger** binds the SAME shared `LV Enrichment Webhook` credential the enrichment trigger uses — one operator secret works against both endpoints with no new provisioning.
